purpose: Generate final normal-job combat data for all canonical Heroes from UnityDataTool direct JSON, including display job stats, Hero-owned soldier modifiers, talent star progression and awakening, while preserving the A-1/A-9 identity and relation ownership boundaries.

sharedRelationBoundary.soldierModifiersMeaning: Hero-owned troop HP/ATK/DEF/MDEF modifier percentages only; this component is not Hero-Soldier membership.
sharedRelationBoundary.futureConsumer: Hero 5-3 consumes the validated data/generated/hero-soldier-by-hero.v1.json index only after the shared Relation Layer is accepted.

awakeningStateModel.verifiedState: AwakenInfo row exists, Awaken2Unlock=true, Level2SkillID is a positive integer and resolves to exactly one SkillInfo.ID.
awakeningStateModel.level2SkillNotDefinedState: AwakenInfo row exists and defines Awaken1LevelID, Awaken2Material and Awaken2LevelID, but does not define Awaken2Unlock or Level2SkillID. This is LEVEL2_SKILL_NOT_DEFINED, not Hero awakening NONE.

semanticGates.rule: For each canonical Hero, resolve the domain-proven same-valued AwakenInfo.ID row. If Level2SkillID is explicitly defined, require Awaken2Unlock=true and an exact SkillInfo.ID reference. If Level2SkillID is absent, preserve the source row as LEVEL2_SKILL_NOT_DEFINED; do not collapse it to Hero awakening NONE.
At Hero Lv70 / 6-star, for each normal JobConnection final JobLevel: round((INI + UP * (70 - 1) / 10) * (1 + HeroInfo.StatStar[5] / 10000)) + global JobInfo mastery flat.
semanticGates.scope: Bond percentage/flat effects are intentionally excluded and remain Hero Stage 5 data.
Hero-owned troop stat metadata only; never usable-Soldier membership.

semanticGates.rule: JobConnectionInfo.TalentSkill_IDs is the verified talent reference set.
TalentSkill_IDs[star - 1] selects the displayed talent for star 1..6; all normal JobConnections for one Hero must carry the same six-slot array.

normalizationRules: Consume Stage 4-3 and Stage 4-4 only when their status is PASS or REVIEW.
Use heroId as the only canonical Hero JOIN key and require exact parity with the frozen 267-record Hero Master.
Select playable HeroInfo records by the presence of the playable-Hero Useable schema; do not take the first duplicate raw ID from the 28k-row mixed table.
Use UnityDataTool direct JSON arrays; legacy TextAsset m_bytes parsing is forbidden in Stage 4-5.

For awakening only, consume the domain-proven canonical Hero.ID -> same-valued AwakenInfo.ID correspondence established by the awakening Z3-Z7 proof. This is a domain-specific frozen relation, not a generic ID-equality heuristic.
Do not use HeroInfo.Awaken_ID as the normal Hero awakening relation. Those sparse references include special/Cutscene rows and are not the canonical Hero-to-AwakenInfo relation.
When an AwakenInfo row defines Level2SkillID, require a positive integer, Awaken2Unlock=true and exact SkillInfo.ID resolution.

When a canonical AwakenInfo row omits both Awaken2Unlock and Level2SkillID, emit level2Status=LEVEL2_SKILL_NOT_DEFINED while preserving the AwakenInfo row identity; never emit Hero awakening NONE for that case.
Do not infer release chronology from Level2SkillID absence, Hero ID, row order, names or numeric patterns.
Use JobInfo Property1-3 rewards only when PropertyModify IDs map to HP=87, AT=88, DF=89, Magic=90, MagicDF=91, DEX=92; unknown nonzero mastery IDs are hard errors.
Compute display stats for each normal JobConnection using its final JobLevel and add global mastered-job flat rewards after star-adjusted rounding.
Keep bond effects outside Stage 4 so Stage 5 can own bond semantics without double counting.
Require six star-correction values for every stat and six TalentSkill_IDs for every Hero talent set.
Keep soldierModifiers limited to Hero-owned troop stat percentages and never embed soldierId arrays or Hero-Soldier membership.
Preserve Stage 4-3 topology and Stage 4-4 skill acquisition payloads without changing their semantic ownership.

FAIL: Canonical Hero, Stage 4-3, Stage 4-4 or playable HeroInfo sets disagree.
A canonical Hero has no exact domain-proven AwakenInfo row.
A Level2SkillID is non-positive, ambiguous or missing from SkillInfo.
A row with Level2SkillID does not define Awaken2Unlock=true.
A row without Level2SkillID defines Awaken2Unlock=true or is collapsed to Hero awakening NONE.
Canonical awakening counts differ from 267 total / 257 Level2 defined / 10 Level2 not defined.
A required Job, JobConnection, JobLevel or Skill reference is missing or ambiguous.
A stat star-correction array or TalentSkill_IDs array is not six slots.
TalentSkill_IDs differ between normal JobConnections of the same Hero.
A nonzero JobInfo mastery PropertyModify ID is outside the verified 87-92 mapping.
A Cmd modifier is negative, non-integer or not divisible by 100.
Stage 4-5 embeds or independently computes usable-Soldier membership.
PASS: 267 records are generated with 267 canonical AwakenInfo rows, 257 VERIFIED Level2 Skill references, 10 LEVEL2_SKILL_NOT_DEFINED source states, zero Hero awakening NONE, all five semantic gates verified, zero hard errors, A-1 identity parity and A-9 ownership preserved.

stage4CompletionRule: Stage 4 is COMPLETE only when the generated summary status is PASS with generatedHeroCount=267, awakening canonical coverage=267, false NONE=0 and unresolvedComponents empty.
nextStage: Proceed to Hero Stage 5. Hero 5-3 usable Soldiers must consume the validated A-7 byHeroId index rather than recomputing membership.
